metadata.title: A Binary Normal Form and an Audited Proof Attempt for the Two-Player 3n+/-1 Game
metadata.description: We study the two-player 3n+/-1 problem stated at https://althofer.de/collatz-prizes.html. An external audit by Ingo Althöfer identified a genuine gap in the old global entry argument. The repaired repository withdraws the invalid coefficient-source inference and proves a universal two-level arithmetic normalization for the previously omitted factorful exponent-one family, but the provenance/rank attachment of that family remains OPEN. Therefore this repair draft does not claim that no DRAW positions have been proved impossible.
metadata.notes: Historical published record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21844684. It predates the external audit and contains the earlier proof claim. Do not publish a replacement proof version while the arbitrary exponent-one attachment lemma in corrected Section 137 remains open. Correspondence: n_854@mail.ru. The routing certificate status CONDITIONAL_MACHINE_CHECK refers only to the declared typed assembly.
